info.name: PixVerse API v2 (web) by useapi.net
info.description:
Full documentation available at [useapi.net](https://useapi.net/docs/api-pixverse-v2).

**Videos:** native PixVerse v6 (default), v5.6, v5.5, v5, v5-fast, pixverse-c1 with Off-Peak mode; third-party seedance-2.0 / seedance-2.0-fast / seedance-2.0-mini (omni: + up to 3 reference videos + 3 reference audios), kling-o3, kling-v3, grok-imagine, veo-3.1-lite, veo-3.1-standard, veo-3.1-fast, sora-2, sora-2-pro, happyhorse-1.0
**Motion Control:** v5.6 character-image-driven-by-video pipeline (POST /videos/motion-control)
**Images:** 10 models including Seedream, Nano Banana, Qwen Image, Kling 3.0 / O3, GPT Image 2.0 (10 aspect ratios at every quality)
**Music:** music-2.6 (MiniMax, default), music-v1 (ElevenLabs), lyria-3-pro-preview (Google) — songs, instrumentals, custom or model-written lyrics

---
**Updated:** June 24, 2026

formdata.description: Optional. Native PixVerse: v6 (default), v5.6, v5.5, v5, v5-fast, pixverse-c1. Third-party: seedance-2.0, seedance-2.0-fast, seedance-2.0-mini, kling-o3, kling-v3, grok-imagine, veo-3.1-lite, veo-3.1-standard, veo-3.1-fast, sora-2, sora-2-pro, happyhorse-1.0 (audio always on). See model-capabilities for per-model constraints.
Optional. Interchangeable with frame_1_path.
Optional. Required when template.effect_type=2. Interchangeable with frame_2_path.
Optional. Multi-input alternative to first_frame_path. Mutex with first_frame_path/last_frame_path.
Optional. Required (with frame_1_path) when template.effect_type = 2, or as part of frame_1_path..frame_N_path for templates with effect_type > 2.
Optional. Use with frame_1_path..frame_2_path when template.effect_type ≥ 3. Templates with effect_type > 2 accept 2 to effect_type inputs (e.g., a 5-input template accepts 2 to 5).
Optional. Use together with frame_1_path..frame_3_path when template.effect_type ≥ 4.
Optional. Use together with frame_1_path..frame_4_path when template.effect_type = 5 (e.g., Family Reunion).
Optional, 1-15 for v6, 1-10 for v5.x (1080p max 8s). Default: 5. Ignored when template_id is set (template's duration is used).
Optional, supported values: 1080p, 720p (v6 default), 540p (v5.x default), 360p. When template_id is set, must be in template.qualities; defaults to template.qualities[0] when omitted.
Optional (v5.5, v5.6, v6). Set to true for integrated audio generation
Optional (v6 only). Set to true for multi-shot storytelling

Optional. Native PixVerse: v5.6 (default), v5.5, v5, v5-fast, pixverse-c1. Third-party: seedance-2.0, seedance-2.0-fast, seedance-2.0-mini, kling-o3, kling-v3, veo-3.1-lite, veo-3.1-standard, veo-3.1-fast

Optional. Default: pixverse-c1. Supported: v5 (uses @pic1/2/3), v5.6 (up to 7 frames), pixverse-c1 (up to 7 frames), seedance-2.0 / seedance-2.0-fast / seedance-2.0-mini (up to 9 frames + up to 3 reference videos via video_1_path…video_3_path + up to 3 reference audios via audio_1_path…audio_3_path), kling-o3 (up to 7 frames). Non-v5 models use @image1...@imageN notation.

Optional (seedance-2.0 family only). Path of uploaded reference video. Reference it in the prompt as @video1. Limits: 2-15 sec, ≤50 MB, 24-60 fps, ≤6000×6000 px. Sum of all reference video durations ≤15 sec.
Optional (seedance-2.0 family only). Second reference video. Reference as @video2. Requires video_1_path.
Optional (seedance-2.0 family only). Third reference video. Reference as @video3. Requires video_2_path.

Optional (seedance-2.0 family only). Path of uploaded reference audio. Reference it in the prompt as @audio1. Limits: each 2-15 sec, sum of all reference audio durations ≤15 sec. Drives speech or sound onto your character (omni mode).
Optional (seedance-2.0 family only). Second reference audio. Reference as @audio2. Requires audio_1_path.
Optional (seedance-2.0 family only). Third reference audio. Reference as @audio3. Requires audio_2_path.
Optional. Default: v5.6 (only supported value today).
Required. Character image path (uploaded via POST /files). Must contain a clear person or animal subject — rejected with 422 otherwise.
Required. Motion video path (uploaded via POST /files). Limits: 1-30 sec, ≤50 MB, ≤1920×1920 px.
Optional. 360p, 540p, or 720p (default).
